description: Prepared triage conversations. For each scenario the phase-1 question set AND every answer-combination handoff are pre-built into the LLM cache (scripts/build-triage-cache.mjs), so any path through the chat replays real Grok output key-free. patient+complaint are cache-key material - never edit a complaint without rebuilding that scenario.
